description: This file contains functions related to handling subagent follow-up logic, including resolving timings, reading descendant replies, and waiting for descendant subagents to complete, within a cron or agent-based system.

methods.name: resolveCronSubagentTimings
methods.description: Determines timing parameters for subagent operations based on environment variables.

methods.name: readDescendantSubagentFallbackReply
methods.description: Retrieves the latest reply from descendant subagents, with fallback to frozen results if needed.

methods.name: waitForDescendantSubagentSummary
methods.description: Waits for all descendant subagents to complete and captures the final assistant reply within a grace period.
